prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one game background layer, factory_wall_corner, RGBA PNG with genuinely transparent pixels below the walls.
Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match its quiet cream interior walls, cool grey-blue baseboard, subtle warm upper-left lighting, gentle painted 3D isometric mobile-game rendering and orthographic projection. Create a NEW WIDE wall-corner layer, not a complete room.
Composition: landscape 2:1 canvas. Two continuous interior walls meet at an inside corner exactly in the horizontal center. They fill the TOP of the entire canvas and continue naturally out through the top and both side edges. No visible wall tops, no outside wall thickness, no detached miniature walls. A very subtle vertical interior corner seam runs down from top center to the baseboard center point at x=50%, y=45%. The grey-blue baseboard has two straight diagonal branches: center-high at (50%,45%), descending to the lower left corner (0%,100%) and lower right corner (100%,100%). This is an INDOOR CONCAVE corner, matching the reference's center-high floor/wall seam. Slight baseboard height only, approximately 5% canvas height, softly highlighted top bevel. Below these diagonal baseboard lower edges the entire bottom central triangular area MUST BE TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, not white, not checkerboard, not a beige floor, no shadows painted into the transparent area. Make all wall pixels opaque above that boundary, reaching all canvas top and side edges.
Palette/materials: warm off-white cream plaster, extremely subtle smooth tonal variation, left wall a little lighter than right; cold desaturated blue-grey skirting. Clean understated environment background so game machinery stays dominant. Very low contrast, no patterned wallpaper, no noise.
No floor, no floor tiles, no platform, no window, no door, no machines, no objects, no decoration, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no people. Preserve crisp silhouette and anti-aliased real alpha at the baseboard underside. Requested output about 1536x768, exact 2:1 if possible, full width walls, no surrounding margin.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit this game wall-corner layer. KEEP THE WALLS AND BLUE-GREY BASEBOARD, dimensions, perspective, colors, top edge and side-edge framing unchanged. The checkerboard printed in the lower central triangular area is an ERROR. Delete every pixel below the lower edge of the two blue-grey baseboards, leaving actual empty TRANSPARENT ALPHA pixels in a genuine RGBA PNG. Do not replace the checkerboard with white, grey, solid color, another checkerboard, texture, floor or shadow. Transparent means alpha=0 below the skirting, not a drawn checkerboard. Preserve opaque cream walls and blue-grey skirting, with anti-aliased alpha at their lower silhouette. Produce a real RGBA PNG suitable for compositing this wall cutout over a separate floor tile.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one transparent-background game environment sprite, a ROOM INTERIOR WALL CORNER STRIP. Deliver actual RGBA PNG with an alpha channel. Use transparent background. Landscape 2:1 dimensions, 512x256 target. This is an isolated wall layer for compositing, with no floor beneath it.
The walls fill the full canvas width and are cut off at the top and both side boundaries, as if the room extends past those edges. Two warm pale cream plaster interior walls intersect at a central vertical inside-corner seam. Subtle low-contrast painted 3D mobile-game style with a soft warm upper-left light. Left wall slightly brighter. A narrow cool desaturated grey-blue baseboard follows both walls: its center point is HIGH at x50%, y45%, then it slopes DOWN to the lower-left and lower-right corners. The lower silhouette is therefore a centered upward chevron, an inside room corner. Smooth simple two-wall surfaces, no top faces or thickness visible.
All the large triangular region BELOW that grey-blue baseboard is empty TRANSPARENT alpha=0. The wall and baseboard are opaque. Clean antialiased baseboard silhouette. Do not draw checkerboard under any circumstances. No floor, no objects, no decoration, no platform, no shadow below the baseboard, no text, no symbols, no outline enclosing the asset, no wall side cut faces. This is a real alpha-transparent isolated sprite, with only the cream walls and grey-blue skirting visible.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background; output PNG with real transparent alpha outside the wall silhouette, no colored backdrop and no checkerboard graphic.
